# Anger and the acceptance of political violence

## Preliminaries

### Libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
library(apollo)
library(survival)
library(lme4)
```

### Tuning parameters

```{r}

RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
masterSeed <- 524

export <- TRUE
```

### Data

```{r}

dataCollapsed <- read_csv("../Data/Base_Maestra_Experimento_Full_Variables_2.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    uniqueID = gsub("_", "", Subject_ID)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    traitAnger = Trait_Anger,
    assetScore = Asset_Score,
    SES = SES_Index,
    studyOrder = Order_First
  ) %>%
  select(uniqueID, traitAnger, assetScore, SES, studyOrder)

response_alternatives <- c("NV", "NPV", "IPV", "RPV")

dataLong <- read_csv("../Data/Base_Larga_Experimento_Final_1-44 - Base_Larga_Experimento_Final_1-44.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(winner_cat)) %>%
  mutate(
    uniqueID = paste0(Session_ID, Participant_ID),
    winner_cat = replace_values(
      winner_cat,
      "VNP" ~ "NPV",
      "VPI" ~ "IPV",
      "VPR" ~ "RPV"
    ),
    loser_cat = replace_values(
      loser_cat,
      "VNP" ~ "NPV",
      "VPI" ~ "IPV",
      "VPR" ~ "RPV"
    ),
    isNV    = as.integer(str_detect(matchup, fixed("NV"))),
    isNPV   = as.integer(str_detect(matchup, fixed("VNP"))),
    isIPV   = as.integer(str_detect(matchup, fixed("VPI"))),
    isRPV   = as.integer(str_detect(matchup, fixed("VPR"))),
    NPV_NV   = ifelse(isNPV == 1 & isNV  == 1, 1, 0),
    IPV_NV   = ifelse(isIPV == 1 & isNV  == 1, 1, 0),
    RPV_NV   = ifelse(isRPV == 1 & isNV  == 1, 1, 0),
    IPV_NPV  = ifelse(isIPV == 1 & isNPV == 1, 1, 0),
    RPV_NPV  = ifelse(isRPV == 1 & isNPV == 1, 1, 0),
    RPV_IPV  = ifelse(isRPV == 1 & isIPV == 1, 1, 0),
    choice   = match(
      as.character(winner_cat),
      response_alternatives
    ),
    treat    = ifelse(tratamiento == "RABIA", 1, 0),
    polId = left_right - 5,
    trial = (trial_n - min(trial_n)),
    trialReset = ifelse(trial_n <= 240, trial_n - min(trial_n), trial_n - min(trial_n) - 240),
    logTrial = log(trial_n),
    logTrialReset = log(ifelse(trial_n <= 240, trial_n, trial_n - 240)),
    blockTwo = ifelse(trial_n > 240, 1, 0),
    male = ifelse(sex=="Hombre", 1, 0),
    age = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    event = as.numeric(!timeout)
  )

mapping <- data.frame(
  image     = c(dataLong$winner_img, dataLong$loser_img),
  category  = c(dataLong$winner_cat, dataLong$loser_cat),
  unity     = 1
) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(
    index = cumsum(unity)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(category, index) %>%
  mutate(
    imgID = paste0(index, "_", category)
  ) %>%
  select(-unity)

dataLong <- dataLong %>%
  mutate(
    winner_img = mapping$imgID[match(winner_img, mapping$image)],
    loser_img  = mapping$imgID[match(loser_img, mapping$image)]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    uniqueID,
    trial,
    choice,
    rt_ms,
    treat,
    polId,
    male,
    age,
    trialReset,
    logTrial,
    logTrialReset,
    blockTwo,
    matchup,
    event,
    isNV,
    isNPV,
    isRPV,
    isIPV,
    NPV_NV,
    IPV_NV,
    RPV_NV,
    IPV_NPV,
    RPV_NPV,
    RPV_IPV,
    winner_img,
    loser_img
  )

uniqueImages <- unique(c(dataLong$winner_img, dataLong$loser_img))

imageMatrix <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(dataLong)),
    function(r){
      img1 <- dataLong$winner_img[r]
      img2 <- dataLong$loser_img[r]
      
      as.numeric(uniqueImages %in% c(img1, img2))
    }
  )
)

colnames(imageMatrix) <- uniqueImages

# Check that only two images are listed for each trial
sum(rowSums(imageMatrix)) / 2 == nrow(dataLong)

imageMatrix <- as.data.frame(imageMatrix) %>%
  mutate(
    uniqueID = dataLong$uniqueID,
    trial = dataLong$trial
  )

dataLong <- dataLong %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -c(winner_img, loser_img)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dataCollapsed, by="uniqueID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    imageMatrix, by = c("uniqueID", "trial")
  )

rm(imageMatrix)
rm(dataCollapsed)
```

## Choice models

### Intercepts baseline

```{r}

apollo_control <- list(
  modelName  = "Nested MNL baseline",
  modelDescr = "Paired-choice nested logit",
  indivID    = "uniqueID",
  panelData  = TRUE,
  nCores     = 4
)

apollo_beta <- c(
  b_intercept_NV  = 0,
  b_intercept_NPV = 0,
  b_intercept_IPV = 0,
  b_intercept_RPV = 0,
  
  # Unrestricted parameters determining the nesting scales
  eta_nest1 = qlogis(0.99)
)

apollo_fixed <- "b_intercept_NV"

apollo_probabilities <- function(
    apollo_beta,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality = "estimate"
) {
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  on.exit(
    apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs),
    add = TRUE
  )
  
  # Utilities: NV is the reference alternative
  V <- list(
    NV = b_intercept_NV,
    
    NPV = b_intercept_NPV,
    
    IPV = b_intercept_IPV,
    
    RPV = b_intercept_RPV
  )
  
  # Enforce 0 < lambda_nest2 < lambda_nest1 < 1
  lambda_nest1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest1))
  
  nl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(
      NV  = 1,
      NPV = 2,
      IPV = 3,
      RPV = 4
    ),
    
    avail = list(
      NV  = isNV,
      NPV = isNPV,
      IPV = isIPV,
      RPV = isRPV
    ),
    
    choiceVar = choice,
    utilities = V,
    
    nlNests = list(
      root  = 1,
      nest1 = lambda_nest1
    ),
    
    nlStructure = list(
      root  = c("NV", "nest1"),
      nest1 = c("NPV", "IPV", "RPV")
    )
  )
  
  P <- list()
  
  P[["model"]] <- apollo_nl(
    nl_settings,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_panelProd(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_prepareProb(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  return(P)
}

apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs(
  apollo_beta    = apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed   = apollo_fixed,
  database       = dataLong,
  apollo_control = apollo_control,
  recycle        = FALSE
)

interceptFit <- apollo_estimate(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed,
  apollo_probabilities,
  apollo_inputs
)

apollo_modelOutput(interceptFit)

# Recover the estimated nesting scales
lambda_nest1_hat <- plogis(
  interceptFit$estimate[["eta_nest1"]]
)

c(
  lambda_nest1 = lambda_nest1_hat
)
```

### Interaction

```{r}

apollo_control <- list(
  modelName  = "Nested MNL",
  modelDescr = "Paired-choice nested logit",
  indivID    = "uniqueID",
  panelData  = TRUE,
  nCores     = 4
)

apollo_beta <- c(
  b_intercept_NV  = 0,
  b_intercept_NPV = 0,
  b_intercept_IPV = 0,
  b_intercept_RPV = 0,
  
  b_treat_NPV  = 0,
  b_treat_IPV = 0,
  b_treat_RPV = 0,
  
  b_polId_NPV  = 0,
  b_polId_IPV = 0,
  b_polId_RPV = 0,
  
  b_interaction_NPV  = 0,
  b_interaction_IPV = 0,
  b_interaction_RPV = 0,

  # Unrestricted parameters determining the nesting scales
  eta_nest1 = qlogis(0.99),
  eta_nest2 = qlogis(0.99)
)

apollo_fixed <- "b_intercept_NV"

apollo_probabilities <- function(
    apollo_beta,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality = "estimate"
) {
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  on.exit(
    apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs),
    add = TRUE
  )
  
  # Utilities: NV is the reference alternative
  V <- list(
    NV = b_intercept_NV,
    
    NPV = b_intercept_NPV +
      b_treat_NPV * treat +
      b_polId_NPV * polId +
      b_interaction_NPV * treat * polId,

    IPV = b_intercept_IPV +
      b_treat_IPV * treat +
      b_polId_IPV * polId +
      b_interaction_IPV * treat * polId,

    RPV = b_intercept_RPV +
      b_treat_RPV * treat +
      b_polId_RPV * polId +
      b_interaction_RPV * treat * polId
  )
  
  # Enforce 0 < lambda_nest2 < lambda_nest1 < 1
  lambda_nest1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest1))
  
  lambda_nest2 <- lambda_nest1 *
    (1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest2)))
  
  nl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(
      NV  = 1,
      NPV = 2,
      IPV = 3,
      RPV = 4
    ),
    
    avail = list(
      NV  = isNV,
      NPV = isNPV,
      IPV = isIPV,
      RPV = isRPV
    ),
    
    choiceVar = choice,
    utilities = V,
    
    nlNests = list(
      root  = 1,
      nest1 = lambda_nest1,
      nest2 = lambda_nest2
    ),
    
    nlStructure = list(
      root  = c("NV", "nest1"),
      nest1 = c("NPV", "nest2"),
      nest2 = c("IPV", "RPV")
    )
  )
  
  P <- list()
  
  P[["model"]] <- apollo_nl(
    nl_settings,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_panelProd(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )

  P <- apollo_prepareProb(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  return(P)
}

apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs(
  apollo_beta    = apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed   = apollo_fixed,
  database       = dataLong,
  apollo_control = apollo_control,
  recycle        = FALSE
)

interactionfit <- apollo_estimate(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed,
  apollo_probabilities,
  apollo_inputs
)

apollo_modelOutput(interactionfit)

# Recover the estimated nesting scales
lambda_nest1_hat <- plogis(
  interactionfit$estimate[["eta_nest1"]]
)

lambda_nest2_hat <- lambda_nest1_hat * plogis(
  interactionfit$estimate[["eta_nest2"]]
)

c(
  lambda_nest1 = lambda_nest1_hat,
  lambda_nest2 = lambda_nest2_hat
)

# Build the four coefficient contrasts for a given pair
make_contrast <- function(a, b, inverse_scale) {
  
  prefixes <- c(
    intercept   = "b_intercept",
    treat       = "b_treat",
    polId       = "b_polId",
    interaction = "b_interaction"
  )
  
  expressions <- sprintf(
    "(%s_%s - %s_%s) * (%s)",
    prefixes, a,
    prefixes, b,
    inverse_scale
  )
  
  setNames(
    expressions,
    paste(a, b, names(prefixes), sep = "_SEP_")
  )
}

contrast_expressions <- c(
  make_contrast(
    "IPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "IPV",
    "(1 + exp(-eta_nest1)) * (1 + exp(-eta_nest2))"
  )
)
```

##### HTML

```{r}

outcomeLevels <- c(
  "NV",
  "NPV",
  "IPV",       
  "RPV"
)

outcomeLabels <- c(
  "NV",
  "NPV",
  "IPV",       
  "RPV"
)

termLevels <- c(
  "treat",
  "polId",       
  "interaction",   
  "intercept"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Treatment",
  "Left-Right (C)",       
  "Treatment × Left-Right",
  "Intercept"
)

interactionTable <- apollo_modelOutput(
  interactionfit,
  list(
    printClassical = FALSE,
    printRobust    = TRUE,
    printPVal      = 2,
    printFixed     = FALSE
  )
)

lambda1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-interactionTable["eta_nest1", "Estimate"]))
lambda2 <- lambda1 * 1 / (1 + exp(-interactionTable["eta_nest2", "Estimate"]))

contrast_results <- apollo_deltaMethod(
  interactionfit,
  list(
    expression = contrast_expressions,
    varcov = "robust",
    printPVal = 2
  )
)

interactionDelta <- tibble::as_tibble(contrast_results) %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
    Expression,
    delim = "_SEP_",
    names = c("Outcome", "Panel", "Term")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Estimate = Value,
    se = s.e.,
    t = `t-ratio (0)`,
    p = `p(2-sided)`
  )

interactionTable <- tibble::as_tibble(
  interactionTable,
  rownames = "Term"
) %>%
  filter(!startsWith(Term, "eta")) %>%
  mutate(
    Panel = "NV",
    Outcome = str_extract(Term, "[^_]*$"),
    Term = str_remove(str_remove(Term, "_[^_]*$"), "^[^_]*_")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    se = Rob.s.e.,
    t = `Rob.t.rat.(0)`,
    p = `p(2-sided)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(interactionDelta) %>%
  mutate(
    Term = factor(
      Term, levels = termLevels, labels = termLabels
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome, levels = outcomeLevels, labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      Panel, levels = outcomeLevels, labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    stars = case_when(
      p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      p < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf(
      "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
      Estimate, stars, se, pFormatted
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Term,
    names_from = c(Panel, Outcome),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Term)

interactionGT <- interactionTable %>%
  gt::gt(
    rowname_col = "Term"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ref: NV",
    columns = starts_with("NV")
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ref: NPV",
    columns = starts_with("NPV")
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ref: IPV",
    columns = starts_with("IPV")
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    ends_with("NPV") ~ "NPV",
    ends_with("IPV") ~ "IPV",
    ends_with("RPV") ~ "RPV"
  ) %>%
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = -Term
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -Term
  ) %>%
  gt::sub_missing(
    columns = -Term,
    missing_text = "—"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(
      groups = everything()
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Verdana", "Arial", "sans-serif"),
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(0),
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = gt::px(1),
    table_body.hlines.width = gt::px(0)
  )

interactionGT

if(export) {
  interactionGT_png <- interactionGT %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.width = gt::px(624)
    )
  
  gt::gtsave(
    interactionGT_png,
    filename = "../Tables/interactionTable.png",
    zoom = 3.125,
    expand = 0
  ) 
}
```

```{r}
apollo_probabilities <- function(
    apollo_beta,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality = "estimate"
) {
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  on.exit(
    apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs),
    add = TRUE
  )
  
  # Utilities: NV is the reference alternative
  V <- list(
    NV = b_intercept_NV,
    
    NPV = b_intercept_NPV +
      b_age_NPV * age +
      b_male_NPV * male +
      b_treat_NPV * treat +
      b_polId_NPV * polId +
      b_trial_NPV * logTrial +
      b_blockTwo_NPV * blockTwo +
      b_trial_blockTwo_NPV * logTrial * blockTwo +
#      b_trialSq_NPV * trial^2 +

      b_treat_trial_NPV * treat * logTrial,

#      b_polId_trial_NPV * polId * logTrial,
#      b_interaction_trial_NPV * treat * polId * logTrial,
    
    IPV = b_intercept_IPV +
      b_age_IPV * age +
      b_male_IPV * male +
      b_treat_IPV * treat +
      b_polId_IPV * polId +
      b_trial_IPV * logTrial +
      b_blockTwo_IPV * blockTwo +
      b_trial_blockTwo_IPV * logTrial * blockTwo +
#      b_trialSq_IPV * trial^2 +

#      b_interaction_trial_RPV * treat * polId * logTrial
  )
  
  # Enforce 0 < lambda_nest2 < lambda_nest1 < 1
  lambda_nest1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest1))
  
  lambda_nest2 <- lambda_nest1 *
    (1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest2)))
  
  nl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(
      NV  = 1,
      NPV = 2,
      IPV = 3,
      RPV = 4
    ),
    
    avail = list(

      NPV = isNPV,
      IPV = isIPV,

  return(P)
}

apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs(

make_contrast <- function(a, b, inverse_scale) {
  
  prefixes <- c(
    intercept         = "b_intercept",
    age               = "b_age",
    male              = "b_male",
#    traitAnger        = "b_traitAnger",
#    SES               = "b_SES",
#    studyOrder        = "b_studyOrder",
    treat             = "b_treat",
    polId             = "b_polId",
    interaction       = "b_interaction",
    trial             = "b_trial",
    blockTwo          = "b_blockTwo",
    trial_blockTwo    = "b_trial_blockTwo",
#    trialSq           = "b_trialSq",
#    trialTwo          = "b_trialTwo",
#    trialTwoSq        = "b_trialTwoSq"
    treat_trial       = "b_treat_trial"
#    polId_trial       = "b_polId_trial",
#    interaction_trial = "b_interaction_trial"
  )
  
  # Include only terms estimated for both alternatives.
  # This accommodates models with or without polId × trial.
  included <- vapply(
    prefixes,
    function(prefix) {
      all(
        paste0(prefix, "_", c(a, b)) %in%
          names(logTrialFit$estimate)
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  
  prefixes <- prefixes[included]
  
  expressions <- sprintf(
    "(%s_%s - %s_%s) * (%s)",
    prefixes, a,
    prefixes, b,
    inverse_scale
  )
  
  setNames(
    expressions,
    paste(a, b, names(prefixes), sep = "_SEP_")
  )
}

contrast_expressions <- c(
  make_contrast(
    "IPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "IPV",
    "(1 + exp(-eta_nest1)) * (1 + exp(-eta_nest2))"
  )
)

contrast_results <- apollo_deltaMethod(
  logTrialFit,
  list(
    expression = contrast_expressions,
    varcov = "robust",
    printPVal = 2
  )
)
```

#### Log trial reset

```{r}

apollo_control <- list(
  modelName  = "Nested MNL, log trial reset",
  modelDescr = "Paired-choice nested logit",
  indivID    = "uniqueID",
  panelData  = TRUE,
  nCores     = 4
)

apollo_beta <- c(
  b_intercept_NV  = 0,
  b_intercept_NPV = 0,
  b_intercept_IPV = 0,
  b_intercept_RPV = 0,
  
  b_treat_NPV  = 0,
  b_treat_IPV = 0,
  b_treat_RPV = 0,
  
  b_polId_NPV  = 0,
  b_polId_IPV = 0,
  b_polId_RPV = 0,
  
  b_polId_trial_NPV = 0,
  b_polId_trial_IPV = 0,
  b_polId_trial_RPV = 0,
  
  b_interaction_NPV  = 0,
  b_interaction_IPV = 0,
  b_interaction_RPV = 0,
  
  b_trial_NPV  = 0,
  b_trial_IPV = 0,
  b_trial_RPV = 0,
  
  b_treat_trial_NPV  = 0,
  b_treat_trial_IPV = 0,
  b_treat_trial_RPV = 0,
  
  b_interaction_trial_NPV  = 0,
  b_interaction_trial_IPV = 0,
  b_interaction_trial_RPV = 0,
  
  # Unrestricted parameters determining the nesting scales
  eta_nest1 = qlogis(0.99),
  eta_nest2 = qlogis(0.99)
)

apollo_fixed <- "b_intercept_NV"

apollo_probabilities <- function(
    apollo_beta,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality = "estimate"
) {
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  on.exit(
    apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs),
    add = TRUE
  )
  
  # Utilities: NPV is the reference alternative
  V <- list(
    NV = b_intercept_NV,
    
    NPV = b_intercept_NPV +
      b_treat_NPV * treat +
      b_polId_NPV * polId +
      b_trial_NPV * logTrialReset +
      b_interaction_NPV * treat * polId +
      b_treat_trial_NPV * treat * logTrialReset +
      b_polId_trial_NPV * polId * logTrialReset +
      b_interaction_trial_NPV * treat * polId * logTrialReset,
    
    IPV = b_intercept_IPV +
      b_treat_IPV * treat +
      b_polId_IPV * polId +
      b_trial_IPV * logTrialReset +
      b_interaction_IPV * treat * polId +
      b_treat_trial_IPV * treat * logTrialReset +
      b_polId_trial_IPV * polId * logTrialReset +
      b_interaction_trial_IPV * treat * polId * logTrialReset,
    
    RPV = b_intercept_RPV +
      b_treat_RPV * treat +
      b_polId_RPV * polId +
      b_trial_RPV * logTrial +
      b_interaction_RPV * treat * polId +
      b_treat_trial_RPV * treat * logTrial +
      b_polId_trial_RPV * polId * logTrial +
      b_interaction_trial_RPV * treat * polId * logTrial
  )
  
  # Enforce 0 < lambda_nest2 < lambda_nest1 < 1
  lambda_nest1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest1))
  
  lambda_nest2 <- lambda_nest1 *
    (1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest2)))
  
  nl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(
      NV  = 1,
      NPV = 2,
      IPV = 3,
      RPV = 4
    ),
    
    avail = list(
      NV  = isNV,
      NPV = isNPV,
      IPV = isIPV,
      RPV = isRPV
    ),
    
    choiceVar = choice,
    utilities = V,
    
    nlNests = list(
      root  = 1,
      nest1 = lambda_nest1,
      nest2 = lambda_nest2
    ),
    
    nlStructure = list(
      root  = c("NV", "nest1"),
      nest1 = c("NPV", "nest2"),
      nest2 = c("IPV", "RPV")
    )
  )
  
  P <- list()
  
  P[["model"]] <- apollo_nl(
    nl_settings,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_panelProd(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_prepareProb(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  return(P)
}

apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs(
  apollo_beta    = apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed   = apollo_fixed,
  database       = dataLong,
  apollo_control = apollo_control,
  recycle        = FALSE
)

logTrialResetFit <- apollo_estimate(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed,
  apollo_probabilities,
  apollo_inputs
)

apollo_modelOutput(logTrialResetFit)

# Recover the estimated nesting scales
lambda_nest1_hat <- plogis(
  logTrialResetFit$estimate[["eta_nest1"]]
)

lambda_nest2_hat <- lambda_nest1_hat * plogis(
  logTrialResetFit$estimate[["eta_nest2"]]
)

c(
  lambda_nest1 = lambda_nest1_hat,
  lambda_nest2 = lambda_nest2_hat
)

make_contrast <- function(a, b, inverse_scale) {
  
  prefixes <- c(
    intercept         = "b_intercept",
    treat             = "b_treat",
    polId             = "b_polId",
    interaction       = "b_interaction",
    trial             = "b_trial",
    treat_trial       = "b_treat_trial",
    polId_trial       = "b_polId_trial",
    interaction_trial = "b_interaction_trial"
  )
  
  # Include only terms estimated for both alternatives.
  # This accommodates models with or without polId × trial.
  included <- vapply(
    prefixes,
    function(prefix) {
      all(
        paste0(prefix, "_", c(a, b)) %in%
          names(logTrialResetFit$estimate)
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  
  prefixes <- prefixes[included]
  
  expressions <- sprintf(
    "(%s_%s - %s_%s) * (%s)",
    prefixes, a,
    prefixes, b,
    inverse_scale
  )
  
  setNames(
    expressions,
    paste(a, b, names(prefixes), sep = "_SEP_")
  )
}

contrast_expressions <- c(
  make_contrast(
    "IPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "IPV",

  )
)

contrast_results <- apollo_deltaMethod(

    printPVal = 2
  )
)
```

```{r}
      b_interaction_IPV * treat * polId +
      b_treat_trial_IPV * treat * logTrial,
    
    RPV = b_intercept_RPV +
      b_age_RPV * age +
      b_male_RPV * male +
      b_treat_RPV * treat +
      b_polId_RPV * polId +
      b_trial_RPV * logTrial +
      b_interaction_RPV * treat * polId +
      b_treat_trial_RPV * treat * logTrial
  )
  
  for (cat in c("NV", "NPV", "IPV", "RPV")) {
    for(img in apollo_inputs$dummyList[[cat]]) {
      V[[cat]] <- V[[cat]] +
        get(paste0("b_img", img)) * get(img)
    }
  }
  
  # Enforce 0 < lambda_nest2 < lambda_nest1 < 1
  lambda_nest1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest1))
  
  lambda_nest2 <- lambda_nest1 *
    (1 / (1 + exp(-eta_nest2)))
  
  nl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(
      NV  = 1,
      NPV = 2,
      IPV = 3,
      RPV = 4
    ),
    
    avail = list(
      NV  = isNV,
      NPV = isNPV,
      IPV = isIPV,
      RPV = isRPV
    ),
    
    choiceVar = choice,
    utilities = V,
    
    nlNests = list(
      root  = 1,
      nest1 = lambda_nest1,
      nest2 = lambda_nest2
    ),
    
    nlStructure = list(
      root  = c("NV", "nest1"),
      nest1 = c("NPV", "nest2"),
      nest2 = c("IPV", "RPV")
    )
  )
  
  P <- list()
  
  P[["model"]] <- apollo_nl(
    nl_settings,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_panelProd(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  P <- apollo_prepareProb(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  return(P)
}

apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs(
  apollo_beta    = apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed   = apollo_fixed,
  database       = dataLong,
  apollo_control = apollo_control,
  recycle        = FALSE
)

apollo_inputs$dummyList <- dummyList

fixedEffectsFit <- apollo_estimate(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed,
  apollo_probabilities,
  apollo_inputs
)

apollo_modelOutput(fixedEffectsFit)

# Recover the estimated nesting scales

lambda_nest2_hat <- lambda_nest1_hat * plogis(

)

c(

  lambda_nest2 = lambda_nest2_hat
)


make_contrast <- function(a, b, inverse_scale) {
  
  prefixes <- c(
    intercept         = "b_intercept",
    age               = "b_age",
    male              = "b_male",
    treat             = "b_treat",
    polId             = "b_polId",
    interaction       = "b_interaction",
    trial             = "b_trial",
    treat_trial       = "b_treat_trial"
  )
  
  # Include only terms estimated for both alternatives.
  # This accommodates models with or without polId × trial.
  included <- vapply(
    prefixes,
    function(prefix) {
      all(
        paste0(prefix, "_", c(a, b)) %in%
          names(fixedEffectsFit$estimate)
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  
  prefixes <- prefixes[included]
  
  expressions <- sprintf(
    "(%s_%s - %s_%s) * (%s)",
    prefixes, a,
    prefixes, b,
    inverse_scale
  )
  
  setNames(
    expressions,
    paste(a, b, names(prefixes), sep = "_SEP_")
  )
}

contrast_expressions <- c(
  make_contrast(
    "IPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "NPV",
    "1 + exp(-eta_nest1)"
  ),
  
  make_contrast(
    "RPV", "IPV",
    "(1 + exp(-eta_nest1)) * (1 + exp(-eta_nest2))"
  )
)

contrast_results <- apollo_deltaMethod(
  fixedEffectsFit,
  list(
    expression = contrast_expressions,
    varcov = "robust",
    printPVal = 2
  )
)
```

## Duration models

### Helpers

```{r}

coxExtractor <- function(coxFit, data) {
  
  predictors <- attr(coxFit$terms, "term.labels")
  
  modelVariables <- predictors[
    !grepl("^(strata|cluster|tt)\\(|:", predictors)
  ]
  
  used <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      if_all(all_of(modelVariables), ~ !is.na(.x))
    )
  
  n_distinct(used$uniqueID)
}

processCoxFun <- function(coxFit, modelName, data) {
  nRisk <- coxFit$n
  nClusters <- coxExtractor(coxFit=coxFit, data=data)
  rsq <- summary(coxFit)$rsq
  r2 <- unname(rsq["rsq"] / rsq["maxrsq"])
  
  processed <- as.data.frame(summary(coxFit)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
    rename(
      Estimate=coef,
      SE = `robust se`,
      Z = z,
      P = `Pr(>|z|)`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Response="Choice",
      Model=modelName,
      Panel="Coefficients",
    ) %>%
    select(Response, Model, Panel, Term, Estimate, SE, Z, P) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      tibble(
        Response="Choice",
        Model=modelName,
        Panel="Info",
        Term=c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2", "N", "Events", "Clusters"),
        Estimate=c(coxFit$concordance[["concordance"]], r2, nRisk, coxFit$nevent, nClusters),
        SE=c(coxFit$concordance[["std"]], rep(NA_real_, times=4)),
        Z=NA_real_,
        P=NA_real_
      )
    )
  
  return(processed)
}
```

```{r}
  coxTableNPV_NV,
  coxTableIPV_NV,
  coxTableRPV_NV,
  coxTableIPV_NPV,
  coxTableRPV_NPV,
  coxTableRPV_IPV
) %>%
  filter(
    Term %in% termLevels
  ) %>%
  group_by(Response, Model, Panel, Term) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      P < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P)))
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      Panel == "Coefficients" ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      Term %in% c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2") ~ sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.0f", Estimate)
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c("Coefficients", "Info"),
      labels = c("Coefficients", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      Term, 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  )

  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = gt::cells_stubhead()
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    ),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_stub(
        rows = Term == "Concordance"
      ),
      gt::cells_body(
        rows = Term == "Concordance"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = gt::cells_stub(
      rows = everything()
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Verdana", "Arial", "sans-serif"),
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(0),
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = gt::px(1),
    table_body.hlines.width = gt::px(0),
    table.width = gt::px(624)
  )

coxGT <- coxGT %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::px(624)
  )

gt::gtsave(
  coxGT,
  filename = "../Tables/coxTable.png",
  zoom = 3.125,
  expand = 0
)

coxGT
```
